ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

19. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

31. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
